name: Aldy Oscar Pancasila Loing
title: Information Systems Graduate — Software Engineer
summary: Aldy is a Cum Laude Information Systems graduate with a strong background in developing digital solutions that combine technology, data, and real-world impact. He has experience building and deploying a wide range of applications, including web-based platforms, AI-powered systems, and community-focused digital tools, with a particular interest in transparency, sustainability, and user-centered design. His projects span personal AI applications, financial and administrative systems, and social innovation initiatives, reflecting both technical versatility and problem-solving ability. Recognized at the national level through innovation and community empowerment programs, and supported by intensive training in cloud computing and industry best practices, Aldy brings a multidisciplinary mindset, strong collaboration skills, and a commitment to creating meaningful, scalable, and responsible technology solutions.
